u10-l1#0.picture: At a newspaper kiosk on a street corner, magazines hanging all round its window, Emma buys a newspaper from the vendor and tucks it under her arm.

u10-l1#1.picture: In the café near the university, Emma spreads the newspaper on the table and reads an article, a finger following the lines, her coffee going cold beside her.

u10-l1#4.picture: Evening in the porter's lodge: pán Kováč watches the news on a small TV, a newsreader at a desk on the screen, a mug of tea in his hand.

u10-l1#5.picture: At the newspaper kiosk, Lucia takes a glossy magazine off the rack and flips through its colourful pages.

u10-l1#9.picture: Two halves, as if two newspaper pages came to life. Left: an ice hockey player shoots the puck into the net. Right: a violinist plays on a concert stage under a spotlight.

u10-l2#0.picture: The weather page of the newspaper, open on the dorm kitchen table: a map of Slovakia covered in little sun, cloud, rain and snow symbols. Emma studies it over breakfast.

u10-l2#2.picture: Tomáš on the same park bench as in the other weather pictures, under a thick grey sky with no sun at all, zipping up his hoodie.

u10-l2#5.picture: Two halves. Left: Emma in a T-shirt and sunglasses fans herself on the sunny Danube embankment. Right: Emma, bundled up in a woolly hat and scarf, shivers on a snowy mountain path in the Tatras.

u10-l2#10.picture: At the dorm kitchen table, Lucia reads the small-ads page of the newspaper, a grid of little boxed ads, and circles one in red pen.

u10-l2#11.picture: Emma, reading the small ads, points out one with a little drawing of a person at a computer; Tomáš leans over her shoulder, interested.

u10-l5#7.picture: Emma bursts into the dorm kitchen waving the newspaper, open at a page with a photo of Lucia; Lucia, mid-bite of toast, stares at it in surprise.
